sections.Profile:
"Beatniks" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in January 1967. The game features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, and two rollunder lanes.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1967
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Party, Dancing, Original Theme, Music, Single level playfield
